purpose: Independent integration acceptance harness. It drives only a temporary fixture root through the candidate HTTP server and injects mock provider, adapter, and sandbox boundaries.

owned.acceptance: User can review an edited prompt before send; earlier device commands are never reversed or repeated silently.
checks: the original HTTP run persists one diagnostic evidence record
an explicit edited send creates one fresh run whose provider payload contains the edited prompt and omits the original prompt/later evidence
the original evidence remains unchanged and the diagnostic command call count does not increase during the edited run
repeating the edited request id is rejected without another provider or device call
owned.limitation: The backend fixture exercises the actual HTTP/provider/sandbox boundaries; the browser edit dialog and explicit resend gesture require the assembled UI rerun.

owned.acceptance: Queued follow-up messages stay ordered and are never submitted twice.
checks: chat first run reaches terminal evidence before the next queued message is submitted
next queued message is submitted exactly once and preserves inspect mode
same requestId/idempotencyKey is rejected without a second provider or sandbox call

with the candidate's allowConcurrentRuns contract enabled, a different chat can complete while one chat is active, while a second active request for the same chat is rejected without a provider or device call
owned.limitation: The harness enables the candidate's per-chat concurrency option and models the browser queue with ordered HTTP requests; it does not certify packaged UI persistence or a physical user gesture.

owned.acceptance: Reload retains queue state and resume is intentional; editing changes only the selected item.
checks: initial HTTP stop aborts the run and produces no later terminal evidence
answer resumes a waiting run and a subsequent stop cancels the fresh segment
resume keeps the selected mode and does not issue a duplicate dispatch
owned.limitation: This is a service lifecycle fixture; queue editing controls and packaged reload are outside this backend harness.

owned.acceptance: An answer maps to one pending question and stale cards cannot authorize later work.
checks: workflow start returns one pending question with an opaque token
the exact question token resumes the same run with the answer in context
a stale or repeated answer is rejected and does not call the responder again
terminal evidence keeps command, target, status, source, and provider provenance
owned.limitation: No live provider, vault, browser, device, or approval executor is used; only the injected mock responder is exercised.

owned.acceptance: Restart during work preserves transcript and exposes recovery without duplicate execution.
checks: waiting run is recoverable after a server restart
recovered waiting state exposes no question token
restart does not issue a provider or device call
owned.limitation: Restart is simulated by closing and recreating the HTTP server over the same temporary workflow store; packaged app process recovery remains separate.

owned.acceptance: Chats, drafts, queued work, avatars and revert history survive migration exactly.
checks: candidate workspace backup validation, serialization, replacement and parse-on-reload preserve direct and queued chats
drafts, pending queue item mode, pause state, avatars and revert history compare exactly after reload
provider/model, section, connection, sidebar and pane preference fields survive with connection fields normalized off
local coworker notes remain byte-equivalent in the reloaded envelope
owned.limitation: This is an isolated candidate backup/migration contract run using in-memory storage; packaged Electron localStorage startup migration still requires the assembled UI rerun.

owned.acceptance: Editing a local coworker note never implies the next model response used it unless request evidence proves inclusion.
checks: after a local note edit, the captured mock chat request contains no note content
a client attempt to add notes to the strict chat payload is rejected before provider dispatch
owned.limitation: This backend fixture does not click the profile document editor; it captures the HTTP boundary and must be paired with the browser editor interaction in the integrated rerun.

crossCutting: actual createServer HTTP boundary and NDJSON stream are used
explicit provider selection is captured at the request, responder, and mock-provider boundaries
question and steering tokens must remain stream-only and absent from persisted evidence or recovered public state
all network requests are loopback-only and all provider/device boundaries are injected mocks
